### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, about half of the traces contained A28, A30 and A31 (each in about 49% of traces) and the other half contained A32, A33 and A34 (each in about 52% of traces); the two groups never co-occurred. In the later window, all six activities appear in about 98–99% of traces, and A28/A30/A31 always occur before A32/A33/A34. [OCC001-006, REL015-017, REL019-021, REL022-024]
- The start activity A25 previously had outgoing edges to all six activities (each about 15–19% of its transitions). In the later window it goes almost exclusively to A28, A30 and A31 (about 31%, 38% and 30% respectively) and almost never to A32/A33/A34 (each ≤1%). [DIR001]
- The intermediate activities A28, A30 and A31 previously went directly to A26 (about 30–36% of their transitions) and to each other. In the later window they go to A32/A33/A34 (each about 10–13%) and almost never to A26 (≤0.5%). [DIR002-004]
- Positions shifted: A25 and A28/A30/A31 occur earlier in the trace (mean position decreased by about 0.05–0.07), while A26 and A32/A33/A34 occur later (mean position increased by about 0.03–0.04). [POS001-008]
- The distance between A25 and A32/A33/A34, and between A28/A30/A31 and A26, increased from 1–3 steps to 4–5 steps. [LAG001-006]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change from two alternative branches — one containing A28/A30/A31 and the other A32/A33/A34 — to a sequential execution in which A28/A30/A31 are followed by A32/A33/A34 before ending at A26. The two groups went from never co-occurring to co-occurring in about 98% of traces, with a fixed order (first group before second group). A25 now leads only to the first group, and the first group no longer leads directly to A26 but to the second group. The position and lag shifts are consistent with this reordering. A limitation is that the order within each group remains mixed (e.g., A28 and A30 appear in both orders), and the evidence does not show whether A26 is reached directly from the second group or through additional steps, though A26 remains present in all traces.

Other differences: None beyond the main hypothesis.
